title: HSK 2.18 · 相机, 药店, 词典, 信用卡
focus: 图片 · 熟 · 亿 · 相机 · 影片 · 温度 · 重视 · 洗澡 · 今后 · 这时 · 计算机 · 刻 · 参观 · 信用卡 · 超市 · 忽然 · 这时候 · 护照 · 气温 · 大自然 · 照相 · 药店 · 关机 · 常用 · 行人 · 开学 · 洗衣机 · 词语 · 开机 · 字典 · 药水 · 词典 · 药片 · 留学生 · 考生 · 生词 · 那时候 · 短信 · 银行卡
body:
Machines ending in 机 (相机, 计算机, 洗衣机), medicine (药店, 药水, 药片), and dictionaries (字典, 词典). The same few building blocks (机, 片, 药, 词) combine over and over.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 机 | jī | machine (木 + 几 jī) | 相机, 计算机, 关机, 洗衣机, 开机 |
| 片 | piàn | flat piece; film | 图片, 影片, 药片 |
| 药 | yào | medicine (艹 herbs + 约 yuē) | 药店, 药水, 药片 |
| 词 | cí | word | 词语, 词典, 生词 |
| 时 | shí | time | 这时, 这时候, 那时候 |
| 卡 | kǎ | card (sound loan from English) | 信用卡, 银行卡 |
| 温 | wēn | warm | 温度, 气温 |
| 相 / 照 | xiàng / zhào | image / to shine, photograph | 相机, 照相, 护照 |

## Watch out

- 行 is xíng (walk) in 行人 but háng (firm) in 银行卡.
- 相 is xiàng (photo) in 相机, 照相, but xiāng in 相信.
- 字典 is for single characters; 词典 is for words.

cards.Example: 这张图片很好看。 zhè zhāng túpiàn hěn hǎokàn: This picture is nice.
cards.Notes: 图 drawing + 片 flat piece

cards.Example: 我跟他不太熟。 wǒ gēn tā bú tài shú: I don't know him that well.
cards.Notes: 孰 shú (phonetic) + 灬 fire = cooked; often said shóu

cards.Example: 中国有十四亿人。 Zhōngguó yǒu shísì yì rén: China has 1.4 billion people.
cards.Notes: 亻 + 乙 yǐ (phonetic)

cards.Example: 我的相机坏了。 wǒ de xiàngjī huài le: My camera is broken.
cards.Notes: 相 xiàng image + 机 machine

cards.Example: 这部影片很好看。 zhè bù yǐngpiàn hěn hǎokàn: This film is good.
cards.Notes: 影 shadow, image + 片 film

cards.Example: 今天温度很高。 jīntiān wēndù hěn gāo: It's hot today.
cards.Notes: 温 warm + 度 degree

cards.Example: 我们很重视这件事。 wǒmen hěn zhòngshì zhè jiàn shì: We take this very seriously.
cards.Notes: 重 heavy, important + 视 look at = see as important

cards.Meaning: to take a bath or shower
cards.Example: 弟弟在洗澡。 dìdi zài xǐzǎo: Little brother's in the shower.
cards.Notes: Both have 氵 water: 洗 = 氵 + 先 xiān, 澡 = 氵 + 喿 zào

cards.Example: 今后我会多注意。 jīnhòu wǒ huì duō zhùyì: I'll be more careful from now on.
cards.Notes: 今 now + 后 after

cards.Example: 这时，电话响了。 zhèshí, diànhuà xiǎng le: Just then, the phone rang.
cards.Notes: 这 this + 时 time

cards.Example: 他学计算机。 tā xué jìsuànjī: He studies computing.
cards.Notes: 计 count + 算 calculate + 机 machine

cards.Example: 现在三点一刻。 xiànzài sān diǎn yí kè: It's quarter past three.
cards.Notes: 亥 hài (phonetic) + 刂 knife = to carve

cards.Example: 欢迎来参观！ huānyíng lái cānguān: Come and have a look around!
cards.Notes: 参 take part + 观 view

cards.Example: 可以用信用卡吗？ kěyǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ ma: Can I pay by credit card?
cards.Notes: 信用 trust (credit) + 卡 card

cards.Example: 我去超市买菜。 wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi cài: I'm going to the supermarket for groceries.
cards.Notes: 超 super + 市 market

cards.Example: 忽然下起了雨。 hūrán xiàqǐ le yǔ: Suddenly it started raining.
cards.Notes: 忽 sudden (勿 + 心) + 然 (adverb ending)

cards.Example: 这时候他来了。 zhèshíhou tā lái le: That's when he arrived.
cards.Notes: 这 this + 时候 time

cards.Example: 别忘了带护照。 bié wàng le dài hùzhào: Don't forget your passport.
cards.Notes: 护 protect + 照 license, permit

cards.Example: 今天气温很低。 jīntiān qìwēn hěn dī: It's cold today.
cards.Notes: 气 air + 温 warmth

cards.Example: 我喜欢大自然。 wǒ xǐhuan dàzìrán: I love nature.
cards.Notes: 大 great + 自然 nature (自 self + 然 so: so by itself)

cards.Example: 我们一起照相吧。 wǒmen yìqǐ zhàoxiàng ba: Let's take a photo together.
cards.Notes: 照 shine, photograph + 相 image

cards.Example: 附近有药店吗？ fùjìn yǒu yàodiàn ma: Is there a pharmacy nearby?
cards.Notes: 药 medicine + 店 shop

cards.Example: 他的手机关机了。 tā de shǒujī guānjī le: His phone is off.
cards.Notes: 关 close + 机 machine; mirror of 开机

cards.Example: 这是常用的词。 zhè shì chángyòng de cí: This is a common word.
cards.Notes: 常 often + 用 use

cards.Example: 路上行人很少。 lù shang xíngrén hěn shǎo: There are few people on the street.
cards.Notes: 行 xíng walk + 人 person

cards.Example: 下周一开学。 xià zhōuyī kāixué: School starts next Monday.
cards.Notes: 开 open + 学 school

cards.Example: 洗衣机坏了。 xǐyījī huài le: The washing machine is broken.
cards.Notes: 洗 wash + 衣 clothes + 机 machine

cards.Example: 这些词语很常用。 zhèxiē cíyǔ hěn chángyòng: These words are common.
cards.Notes: 词 word + 语 language

cards.Example: 请先开机。 qǐng xiān kāijī: Turn it on first.
cards.Notes: 开 open + 机 machine

cards.Example: 我查一下字典。 wǒ chá yíxià zìdiǎn: Let me look it up in the dictionary.
cards.Notes: 字 character + 典 reference book

cards.Example: 这个药水很苦。 zhège yàoshuǐ hěn kǔ: This medicine is bitter.
cards.Notes: 药 medicine + 水 liquid

cards.Example: 这本词典很有用。 zhè běn cídiǎn hěn yǒuyòng: This dictionary is very useful.
cards.Notes: 词 word + 典 reference book

cards.Example: 这些药片一天吃三次。 zhèxiē yàopiàn yì tiān chī sān cì: Take these pills three times a day.
cards.Notes: 药 medicine + 片 flat piece

cards.Example: 他是个留学生。 tā shì ge liúxuéshēng: He's an international student.
cards.Notes: 留 stay + 学 study + 生 student = student staying abroad

cards.Example: 考生请进来。 kǎoshēng qǐng jìnlai: Candidates, please come in.
cards.Notes: 考 test + 生 student

cards.Example: 这课生词很多。 zhè kè shēngcí hěn duō: This lesson has lots of new words.
cards.Notes: 生 raw, unfamiliar + 词 word

cards.Example: 那时候我才十岁。 nàshíhou wǒ cái shí suì: I was only ten back then.
cards.Notes: 那 that + 时候 time

cards.Example: 我给你发短信。 wǒ gěi nǐ fā duǎnxìn: I'll text you.
cards.Notes: 短 short + 信 letter

cards.Example: 我的银行卡丢了。 wǒ de yínhángkǎ diū le: I lost my bank card.
cards.Notes: 银行 bank (银 silver + 行 háng firm) + 卡 card
